title: Final: pitfalls
sub: Find the bug in each snippet
cards/0/explain: InsertAsync has no await: the commit runs before the inserts finish, and errors get lost.
cards/1/explain: CS1996: await inside lock isn't allowed. Use SemaphoreSlim.WaitAsync.
cards/2/q: A TaskCompletionSource is completed from a library callback while the library holds its internal lock. What should you pass when creating it?
cards/2/explain: Otherwise the waiters' continuations run right under someone else's lock.
cards/3/options/2: In a method that saves to the database
cards/3/explain: Everywhere except handlers, use async Task.
cards/4/q: How can you limit the number of concurrent requests? Select all that apply.
cards/4/options/2: A bounded Channel with N consumers
cards/6/q: Why is IAsyncEnumerable good for reading a huge file?
cards/6/options/0: Items are processed as they're read, without loading the whole file into memory
cards/6/options/2: It reads the file on several threads
cards/6/explain: A stream of data instead of one giant list.
